description: This file contains unit tests for VoicePushToTalkHotkey functionality, including a test actor Counter to track event invocations and a test case verifying that begin and end actions fire once per hold.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: An actor class used to count the number of times begin and end actions are triggered during hotkey interactions.

methods.name: incBegin
methods.description: Increments the count of began events.

methods.name: incEnd
methods.description: Increments the count of ended events.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current counts of began and ended events as a tuple.

methods.name: begin end fires once per hold
methods.description: Asynchronous test verifying that the begin and end actions fire exactly once per holding the hotkey, by simulating modifier state changes and checking the counters.
